# catalyst_cache_segments (Data Source)

List existing Cache segments using the official Catalyst CLI's read endpoint. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.segments.ALL`. It does not read cached values. Segment creation is console-only in the published API documentation. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_cache_segments" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "segments" {
  value = data.catalyst_cache_segments.example.segments
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `segments` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--segments))

<a id="nestedatt--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `segments`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
